claim_boundary: The retained timer family is advanced from the second S-CPU write $00:8077 STA $2140=$01 to the first subsequent S-SMP APUIO synchronization: driver $08E3 MOV A,$00F4+X with X=0 samples port 0=$01 on SPC700 cycle offset 5. All 128 timer phases and all 32 DSP phases remain retained; no oscillator or DSP phase is selected.
partial_resume_policy: Any Version 17 side-effect-free partial instruction is resumed only after S-CPU port 0 is changed to $01. Timer time already elapsed before the rendezvous is not replayed; only the residual instruction cycles advance timer state.
